text:
:bar_chart: Update v1.18.0 is live!

:sparkles: What's new
• Command Palette now available! Press ⌘K (or Ctrl+K) to quickly search and navigate the app :rocket:
• Beautiful new product demo video added to our homepage showcasing what we do best
• Refreshed login pages with our updated branding and a cleaner design :muscle:
• New pilot badge and clearer statistics labels to better understand your data
• Updated BiteClub logo and brand colors for a fresh new look
• Added E2E testing infrastructure for a more reliable experience

:ladybug: Fixes
• Improved employee login flow - no more crashes during authentication
• Fixed language switcher for a smoother multilingual experience
• Better spacing and layout on the landing page for all screen sizes :dart:
• Properly syncing volume state when reopening video modals
• Command palette now shows keyboard shortcuts specific to your device
• Fixed meal selection with better optimistic updates

:zap: Performance
• Dramatically improved attendance pattern processing - from 7 seconds to just 2! :zap:
• Optimized command palette to only load data when you need it
• Removed unused fonts for faster page loads
• Better employee management with proper cleanup of old accounts

:lock: Security
• Command palette access restricted to admin users only for better control

:rocket: Our biggest update yet with powerful navigation tools, performance boosts, and a fresh new look to make your BiteClub experience better than ever!
